# GSE141445/Chen, O QC

```{r}
gse141445.obj <- readRDS("./sc_rds_files/gse141445.rds")
gse141445.obj
```

Estimate Sparsity

```{r}
object <- gse141445.obj
```

```{r}
#Calculate Matrix Sparsity
total_element_wise_counts <- (sum(object@assays$RNA@layers$counts) > 0)
dims <- (nrow(object) * ncol(object))
sparsity <- 1 - (total_element_wise_counts / dims)

cat("Matrix sparsity:", round(sparsity * 100, 1), "%\n")

#UMI distribution - bimodal obviously
umi_counts <- colSums(object@assays$RNA@layers$counts)
cat("Median UMI per droplet:", median(umi_counts), "\n")
cat("Droplets with >500 UMI:", sum(umi_counts > 500) , 
    "(likely cells, will be validated by EmptyDrops)\n")
```

Empty Droplet Detection

```{r}
initial_cell_cnt <- dim(object@assays$RNA@layers$counts)[1]
initial_gene_cnt <- dim(object@assays$RNA@layers$counts)[2]

set.seed(100)
#lower: Droplets with <100 UMI assumed empty. Depending on the experiment this could change
#niters: Iterations for specifying the number of iterations to use for the Monte Carlo p-value calculations.
empty_results <- emptyDrops(m = object@assays$RNA@layers$counts,
                            lower = 100,
                            niters = 10000,
                            test.ambient = TRUE)
```

```{r}
#filtering results
#filter for cells with FDR < 0.01
is_cell <- empty_results$FDR < 0.01
#NA entries are treated as empty
is_cell[is.na(is_cell)] <- FALSE
#filte for validated barcodes
validated_barcodes <- colnames(sce)[is_cell]


# Brief feedback
cat("Droplets tested:", ncol(sce), "\n")
cat("Cells called:", sum(is_cell), 
    "(", round(sum(is_cell)/ncol(sce)*100, 1), "%)\n")
cat("Empty droplets removed:", sum(!is_cell), 
    "(", round(sum(!is_cell)/ncol(sce)*100, 1), "%)\n")

```
